whispers.label: Whispers
whispers.description: A movable whisper panel alongside original chat. Conversations last for this session only.

call-target.label: Call target
call-target.description: Call the selected target without attacking. Sends Control-Shift-Space and requires Guild Wars’ default controls. Inactive while typing.

resign.label: Resign
resign.description: Ask before sending /resign in PvE. Enter confirms; Escape cancels.

character-switch.label: Switch Character
character-switch.description: Search and browse every character. Available without optional Tools.

quick-travel.label: Travel
quick-travel.description: Search destinations and travel between outposts.

quick-item-move.label: Quick Item Move
quick-item-move.description: Control-click items to move whole stacks through open storage or trade windows. Add Shift to choose an amount.

maps.label: Maps
maps.description: Exploration grid and walkable terrain on supported PvE maps.

target-readout.label: Target Distance
target-readout.description: Show distance to the selected target in PvE.

skill-key-labels.label: Skill Key Labels
skill-key-labels.description: Show your own control labels on the eight skill slots.

skill-cooldowns.label: Skill Cooldowns
skill-cooldowns.description: Show numeric recharge timers on the skill bar.

chat-filters.label: Chat Filters
chat-filters.description: Hide selected system notices before they enter chat.

alcohol-timer.label: Alcohol Timer
alcohol-timer.description: A quiet, movable alcohol countdown. Hidden when sober; amber in the last 15 seconds.

reminders.label: Reminders
reminders.description: Remind you in chat before cons, pcons or alcohol run out. Only you see these lines.

effect-timers.label: Effect Timers
effect-timers.description: Show exact remaining time on your native Effects icons.
